name: button
title: Button
description: Sturdy, near-square action. One primary per task region.

aria: Loading sets aria-busy and disables the button
Disabled uses the native disabled attribute
a11y.notes: Never use a <div> with a click handler. Medium buttons are 40px high, small ones 32px (compact 34px, card-footer tile 36px, footer lg 44px), link-style ones 28px (still above the 24px of WCAG 2.5.8); a page's primary action is always medium.
